source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1057 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1057 was established by Ordinance No. 31877, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 26, 2021. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1057 is established on property located on the south side of Royal Lane between the Dallas North Tollway and Preston Road. The size of PD 1057 is approximately 0.68 acres. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 1057A: development plan.

(2) Exhibit 1057B: landscape plan. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 1057A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the D(A) Duplex District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the D(A) Duplex District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the D(A) Duplex District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the D(A) Duplex District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) The following additional main use is permitted by right:

-- Police or fire station limited to a fire station. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the D(A) Duplex District apply.

(b) Police or fire station limited to a fire station.

(1) Front yard. Minimum front yard is 10 feet.

(2) Rear yard. Minimum rear yard is five feet.

(3) Height. Maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(4) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 35 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 1057B). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Ingress/Egress For A Police Or Fire Station
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.113. INGRESS/EGRESS FOR A POLICE OR FIRE STATION LIMITED TO A FIRE STATION.

Ingress and egress must be provided in the locations shown on the development plan. No other ingress or egress is permitted. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Screening For A Police Or Fire Station Limited
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.114. SCREENING FOR A POLICE OR FIRE STATION LIMITED TO A FIRE STATION.

Screening of above-ground fuel storage tanks must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Sidewalks For A Police Or Fire Station Limited
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.115. SIDEWALKS FOR A POLICE OR FIRE STATION LIMITED TO A FIRE STATION.

A minimum five-foot-wide striped pedestrian pathway is required along Royal Lane. Path of travel across fire apparatus drives must be designated by a contrasting surface. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.116. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31877)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1057.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31877)
